summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K/A amending its October 7, 2026 report on the departure of CFO Robert Powers, who left effective September 30, 2026 by mutual agreement with the Board. Under a severance agreement, Powers receives six months of base salary, the balance of his agreed fiscal 2026 bonus, and health benefits through October 31, 2026, against a general release; he stays employed through October 14 to assist transition. Victoria Hay of Flexible Consulting serves as interim CFO while a permanent search proceeds. The filing also terminates his December 2021 employment letter without cause; watch for permanent-CFO timing and any further restatement of terms.
